environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in a pod running php:8.2-fpm with nginx sidecar. The pod has default network policies (allow-all). The application config has an empty federation_hosts array. The pod's service account has no IAM role attached but the node's instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is accessible at 169.254.169.254. DNS resolution within the cluster is unrestricted.
